Novel PacBio isoform analysis

Author

Project

Published

July 30, 2026

1 Scope

This report summarizes novel (PacBio / PB*) isoforms relative to known transcripts across all configured datasets, then contrasts novelty patterns between the HT and UT reference transcriptomes.

Novel isoforms are tagged when oId starts with the configured prefix (PB by default).

ImportantInputs are already reduced to switching genes

All 4 of 4 input ISA objects contain only genes that already pass the gene-level q cutoff (saved after isoformSwitchTestDEXSeq(reduceToSwitchingGenes = TRUE)).

Consequences for everything below: gene counts are genes retained, not genes tested; “present in the other dataset” means retained in that saved object, not tested and non-significant; and any percentage of genes has a denominator that was already selected on the outcome. Overlap between datasets is bounded by how many symbols survive in both objects. No enrichment test against this background is reported. See docs/REVIEW_CHANGES.md.

5 Notes

  • Overlap uses gene symbols, because XLOC_* / ISA gene IDs are transcriptome-specific.
  • “Novel involved” means at least one significant switching isoform is tagged PacBio novel under config q / |dIF| cutoffs.
  • Rebuild with:
Rscript scripts/03_novel_isoform_analysis.R
quarto render reports/novel_isoform_analysis.qmd
